method: EXPECTED = trusted current parent (release_index.live_index over the committed authority of the 13 live markets, checked against the deployed record, the global manifest and the deployment pin) + the SEALED Charlotte package (index_from_package). ACTUAL = every registered market's committed authority with Charlotte participating (index_from_committed). Compared as COMPLETE SETS: market ids, participation flags, profile identity keys, record digests, routes, ownership, corridor routes, market routes, verified-no-pets and census counts. Aggregates are checked in addition, never instead.
circularity_guard: the expected pin block and the expected release are derived from the sealed package and the live parent; the candidate's own derivation is only ever the ACTUAL side. A package that keeps the declared digests but drops a record fails re-seal and covers nothing (test case 13).

change_set.why: every changed path is one registration role for charlotte-nc or a narrow companion, and the only blockers are the two the registration owns

participation.why: one row added at SOURCE_READY_BUT_NOT_FOUNDER_AUTHORIZED_FOR_LAUNCH by a non-founder writer; every other row, the authorized set and the chain are carried forward exactly

release_contract.why: a new contract instance: shared release rules identical to every base contract, data fields recognized, numbers agree with derive_authority

build_closure.why: the closure gains exactly the market's two declared inputs and one note; code modules, per-market inputs and every build control are unchanged

derived_globals.why: the committed globals are byte-identical to a regeneration from the shards and no other market's shard changed, so their diff is exactly charlotte-nc's contribution

sealed_package.why: package pkg-charlotte-nc-a2968cc09330c85d is sealed from exactly the head bytes, for REGISTERED_LIVE, declaring one joining market against the current live parent

fast_receipt.why: receipt pkg-charlotte-nc-a2968cc09330c85d-47e0b04c943d167d.json: 15/15 PASS, 0 UNKNOWN, 0 FAILED, bound to the package, the live parent, the intended delta and the current lane and builder versions

expected_release.why: EXPECTED (live parent + sealed package) and ACTUAL (committed authority) agree as complete sets: 14 markets, 1008 profiles, 1150 routes; 0 unexpected changes

identity_routes.why: release_index.compare is clean over both the expected and the actual release: no cross-market identity collision, no duplicate route, no ownership movement, every live member preserved, every change declared

market_state_pin.why: the pin gains exactly one block whose eight counts equal what the sealed package derives, agrees with the release contract, and every other block is byte-identical

release_integrity.why: no deployment authorization, record, manifest, activation flag, production gate or deployment pin moved; the live parent is verified and the authorized set is unchanged
